scenarios.name: who may create a task, for whom
W1: a leader assigns in their division and the assignee joins the project
the assignee works the task: start, block, unblock, submit
W3: whoever assigned it may start it but never submit it
two approvals in order, and nobody approves their own work
a rejection needs a comment, restarts both approvals, and only a stage holder may
a leader doing their own task skips stage 1: the PM approves it straight away
staff assigning an intern: the intern starts it, the assigner can too
